property_summary: collectDrugs must never decrease a user's Kilos balance: after initialization, receiving free kilos, and collecting after enough elapsed time, Kilos[msg.sender] stays >= STARTING_KILOS; the mutant subtracts newKilo so the balance drops below STARTING_KILOS.
change_summary: Change the Kilos update from adding to subtracting newKilo, so Kilos decreases (or the call reverts) instead of increasing.
